title: Mollifiers form an approximate identity in L^2(R^n; E)
statement: Let n be a natural number, E a real Banach space, and mu Lebesgue measure on R^n. Let H : R^n -> E be integrable with H in L^2(mu; E). For j in N let rho_j : R^n -> R be continuous with rho_j >= 0 and int rho_j = 1, and let eps_j in R satisfy rho_j(z) = 0 whenever ||z|| >= eps_j, with eps_j -> 0. Then int^-_x ||int_z rho_j(z) H(x - z) dz - H(x)||_e^2 dx -> 0 as j -> infinity (lintegrals of squared extended norms).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (H : Rn n → E), Integrable H → MemLp H 2 volume → ∀ (ρ : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ j, Continuous (ρ j)) → (∀ j z, 0 ≤ ρ j z) → (∀ j, ∫ z, ρ j z = 1) → (∀ j z, ε j ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ j z = 0) → Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ‖(∫ z, ρ j z • H (x - z)) - H x‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)
